physics-h3-q2.material: Walax la shubay oo cufnaantiisu tahay m iyo dallaaddu tahay q ayaa si toosan ugu soo gala goob magnetic isku mid ah B xawaare v, wuxuuna sameeyaa dhaqdhaqaaq goobaabin joogto ah. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa radius r iyo muddada T ee wareegga goobaabinta?

Iyadoo aan jirin iska caabin hawo, xagalka tuurista θ ee siinaya xadka jiifka ugu badan, iyo xagalka tuurista kale ee siinaya isla xadka jiifka sida xagalka tuurista 30°?

physics-killer-12.title: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-12.topic: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-12.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-12.material: Laba tareen oo koronto-qaadaya oo is-barbar socda oo u dhexeeya masaafo $\\ell=0.5\\,\\mathrm{m}$ ayaa ku jira dusha jiifka ah, waxaana lagu xidhay hal dhammaad iyagoo dhex mara resistor. Wareegga xidhan ee ay sameeyaan tareennada, usha qaada korontada iyo resistor-ka wuxuu leeyahay caabbin guud oo $2\\,\\Omega$ ah. Goob magnetic toosan oo isku mid ah $B=0.5\\,\\mathrm{T}$ ayaa daboolaysa wareegga oo dhan, ushuna wuxuu ku socdaa tareennada xawaare joogto ah oo $4\\,\\mathrm{m/s}$ isagoo ka fogaanaya resistor-ka. Intii ushu dhaqaaqay $0.5\\,\\mathrm{s}$ $2\\,\\mathrm{m}$, flux-ga magnetic ee wareegga ayaa isbeddelay $\\Delta\\Phi=B\\ell\\Delta x$. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, cabbirka korontada la sababay ee wareegga iyo cabbirka xoogga dibadda ee loo baahan yahay si ushu u ku sii socdo xawaare joogto ah? (Xoqitaan ma jiro.)

Wareegga xidhan ee ay sameeyaan tareennada, usha qaada korontada iyo resistor-ka wuxuu leeyahay caabbin guud oo $2\\,\\Omega$ ah. Goob magnetic toosan oo isku mid ah $B=0.5\\,\\mathrm{T}$ ayaa daboolaysa wareegga oo dhan, ushuna wuxuu ku socdaa tareennada xawaare joogto ah oo $4\\,\\mathrm{m/s}$ isagoo ka fogaanaya resistor-ka. Intii ushu dhaqaaqay $0.5\\,\\mathrm{s}$ $2\\,\\mathrm{m}$, flux-ga magnetic ee wareegga ayaa isbeddelay $\\Delta\\Phi=B\\ell\\Delta x$. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, cabbirka korontada la sababay ee wareegga iyo cabbirka xoogga dibadda ee loo baahan yahay si ushu u ku sii socdo xawaare joogto ah? (Xoqitaan ma jiro.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.explain: $\\Delta\\Phi=B\\ell\\Delta x=0.5\\cdot0.5\\cdot2=0.5\\,\\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\\mathcal E|=\\dfrac{\\Delta\\Phi}{\\Delta t}=\\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\\,\\mathrm{V}$ (waxay ku heshiisaa $=B\\ell v=0.5\\cdot0.5\\cdot4$). $I=\\dfrac{\\mathcal E}{R}=\\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\\,\\mathrm{A}$. Xoogga magnetic-ka ee ushu saaran yahay waa $F=BI\\ell=0.5\\cdot0.5\\cdot0.5=0.125\\,\\mathrm{N}$ (iyadoo ka soo horjeedda dhaqdhaqaaqa, sharciga Lenz), sidaas darteed xoogga dibaddu waa $0.125\\,\\mathrm{N}$ sidoo kale. Hubin: awoodda $Fv=0.125\\cdot4=0.5\\,\\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\\cdot2$. Ka tegidda $\\ell$ waxay bixisaa $I=1.0\\,\\mathrm{A}$ (doodda 1); ka tegidda $\\ell$ xoogga waxay bixisaa $0.25\\,\\mathrm{N}$ (doodda 2); isku dhufashada $\\mathcal E$ $\\frac12$ waxay bixisaa doodda 4.
